deploy-bot: [DEPLOY START] release=v2.7.1 target=prod stage=canary group=A(5%) change_window=2024-06-05T02:00:00Z/2024-06-05T03:00:00Z. preflight=passed

maria: Kicking off canary now. I'll keep the SLO dashboard open. p95 latency target <150ms, error rate target <0.5% for 5m.

ajay: Dashboard link: https://grafana.redwood.internal/d/slo/production-overview (watching svc:inference, svc:routing, model:v2.7.1). Also added a temporary panel for canary group A.

sre-oncall: Alerting thresholds I set for this window: error_rate >= 0.5% for 5m -> P1; p95 latency >= 200ms for 3m -> page. Runbook pinned: https://wiki.redwood/company/runbooks/deploy-failures. If either fires, recommend immediate pause and triage.

deploy-bot: [CANARY HEALTH] t=02:05Z group=A error_rate=0.12% p95=138ms infra_errors=0 model_decode_errors=0

kai: Seeing a few model decode warnings in the logs? small burst around 02:07Z. snippet: ```2024-06-05T02:07:12Z WARN model.decode: tokenizer mismatch for request id=xx-yy``` Not trending yet.

maria: thanks @kai — keep an eye. I'll watch sampling and token-level errors. If it crosses 0.4% I'll pause.

ajay: Also FYI, I pinned routing config for canary to route only new-tokens to v2.7.1, kept KV cache on v2.7.0 to avoid cold-start regressions.

deploy-bot: [CANARY HEALTH] t=02:12Z group=A error_rate=0.48% p95=160ms infra_errors=0 model_decode_errors=0

sre-oncall: p95 is creeping but still below 200ms. Error rate at 0.48% is right near our soft threshold. If we hit >=0.5% sustained for 5m -> escalate.

kai: I'm seeing repeated `model.decode` warnings now, rate ~0.15% of requests. Logs: ```ERROR model.decode: invalid token sequence idx=472 err=DecoderFailure``` Could be a tokenizer edge-case introduced in v2.7.1.

olivia: I'm getting small customer reports of truncated responses in canary. Not many but matches the timeframe.

maria: Given the error trend + customer reports, I'm inclined to pause and roll back the canary to v2.7.0. Thoughts?

sre-oncall: Support pausing. Rollback criteria met: error >= 0.5% within change window OR user-facing truncations confirmed. We have both borderline errors and customer reports. Recommend rollback for canary group A only, then run a targeted test suite.

ajay: If we rollback, let's pin the routing and the model version in the cluster: `kubectl set image deploy/inference inference-model=redwood/v2.7.0` and update canary routing rule to previously-stable. Also leave the deployment artifacts for debugging for 1 hour.

maria: executing pause and rollback for canary group A now. Rolling to v2.7.0 and unpinning the new tokenizer config.

deploy-bot: [ROLLBACK START] release_from=v2.7.1 rollback_to=v2.7.0 scope=canary-group-A initiated_by=maria at=02:18Z

deploy-bot: [ROLLBACK COMPLETE] rollback_to=v2.7.0 success=true duration=92s verified_checks=(canary_traffic_ok, no_model_decode_errors)

kai: post-rollback logs show model.decode warnings drop to 0 within 2m. Sample: ```2024-06-05T02:20:15Z INFO model.decode: tokenizer loaded=redwood-v2-std```

olivia: customer reports cleared. Thanks team.

maria: Good catch everyone. We'll open a follow-up issue to repro the tokenizer edge-case against v2.7.1 with a smaller prompt corpus, include the failing request ids, and block a full rollout until fixed. I'll also update release notes: "v2.7.1: rolled back canary due to tokenizer edge-case causing truncated output; investigating."

sre-oncall: Closing the incident for now. Recommend running an extended preflight including tokenization fuzz tests and warm KV cache before next attempt.

ajay: Noted — I'll add automated fuzz tests into the preflight pipeline and add a metric for tokenizer_decrypt_errors so we can alert earlier.

maria: Postmortem and release checklist update planned. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: [DEPLOY WINDOW CLOSED] change_window_end=2024-06-05T03:00:00Z final_state=canary_rolled_back_to_v2.7.0
